items.title: China's BYD launched EV mini-car in Japan
items.summary: The launch highlights the growing challenge Chinese automakers pose to Japanese rivals, which have been losing ground to BYD and other domestic EV makers in China, the world's largest auto market.

items.title: Toyota launches all-new Hilux in India at ₹31.99 lakh, adds 4x2 automatic variant
